goal: Cut GX consumer CPU load (it saturates while scanning: 80-88% busy, about 45 FPS) by reusing expanded display-list vertices across passes and frames.

design.file: runtime/include/hle/prime_dl_vertex_cache.h (new); integrated in runtime/src/hle/gx/gx_dl.cpp TrySubmitPrimePackedDl before PrimeDlVertices::Expand.
design.key: source pointer, byte count, vertex count, format, LayoutSignature (attribute sizes, index widths, groups, array bases and strides).
reuse_proofs: XXH3 of the encoded source bytes is unchanged
the folded GxGuestWrite generation of every array span the indices read (min..max index) is unchanged; generations advance on DMA and on the DC flush/store/zero hooks
spans in uncached mirrors (0xC0000000 and up) and multi-group attributes are never cached
design.race: Generations are sampled before expansion, so a racing write leads to a re-expansion, never a stale reuse.
design.budget: 64 MiB LRU, owned by the GX interpreting thread; entries above 1/8 of the budget are not stored.
design.switch: WII_COMPILED_DISABLE_DL_VERTEX_CACHE=1 disables it for A/B comparison; [prime-dl-vertex-cache] stats every 65,536 lookups.

expected: Roughly the Expand share of the GX thread (ExpandMappedAttribute about 14% self in the slow scan seconds) on reused static geometry. The Aurora FIFO decode and BP state work remain.

validation.tests: new mkw_prime_dl_vertex_cache_tests (reuse, array/source invalidation, layout key, untracked, budget) and mkw_gx_fifo_storage_tests pass
validation.user: pending: geometry correct (animated and moving objects), F8 while scanning, hit rate in console.log

rules: Do not drop the source-digest or generation checks: the previous code avoided any cross-draw memo for correctness. See recomp/docs/copias_efb_y_cache.md for the DC notification rules this relies on.

regression_found.symptom: Sustained 20-50 FPS, no shader stalls (pipelines 0-0.7 s lost); the GX thread is 77-93% busy in the slow seconds.
regression_found.cause: The unordered_map lookup (node and generation loads: memory latency) cost 22% of the GX thread self time in the slow seconds. Draw sizes from F5/F7 dumps: 71% of draws have 16 vertices or fewer, under 1% have more than 64, so for most draws the key/digest/lookup cost more than the expansion it skipped.
fix: The cache only applies to draws of 48 vertices or more (kMinCachedVertices).

Attribute-plan reuse in TrySubmitPrimePackedDl: the plan is rebuilt only when the format, vtxStateGeneration or the base/stride of an indexed array changes (GXSetArray and CP 0xA0/0xB0 do not bump the generation, so they are compared explicitly).
